notes.title: A new Gladiator game just Launched
notes.content:
Hello Gladiators, 

I just wanted to let you all know that a dear fellow solo developer, Jordy, has just launched his game which has been working on it for 7 years!
It's a roguelike arena based gladiator games with physics and directional combat... It looks awesome and it's very fun to play.

Here are a few words from Jordy : 
[i]The excitement for the game has been overwhelming - especially this last week - everyone who has left feedback, wishlisted, played the demo, entered the arena, fought and died gloriously - THANK YOU!
With much love, I am happy to say: after 7 years of solo development We Who Are About To Die is OUT NOW! 

Fight & strategize your way through spectacles and arenas -- rise from lowly slave to Grand Champion and earn your freedom. Or... die trying. This Gladiator RPG Roguelite features in-depth career management and a unique physics simulated combat system. To those who are about to die, I salute you!

At request - the game has launched with a fully optional supporter pack that includes soundtrack, illustrations, concept art and development screenshots, which you can buy in a bundle together with the game. This pack does not affect the game at all - to be clear. It is only for people who wanted to go the extra mile and support the development of this game with a little extra.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/973230/We_Who_Are_About_To_Die/

See you in the arena, Gladiators!

notes.title: Piratopia is back!
notes.content:
Hello Friends!

First of all, thank you for sticking around and supporting me even during the period when there were no updates… I have BIG EXCITING NEWS!!!

I’m ecstatic to announce that I’ve partnered with a global publisher, Project 99 https://project99.gg/ to expand and launch Piratopia 2.0, one of my personal games!

Project 99 is a brand new publisher and, after getting to know the team in the past months, I’m impressed by how much they love Piratopia and the extensive experience they have in building games!

We share the same vision of making the most badass pirate game with a focus on the community and inclusive feedback to shape the game’s roadmap. There is a lot of exciting stuff we’re planning already, from improved graphics to more content and bosses!

Join the dedicated Discord server to take part in polls, peek at what we’ll be working on, and even score some freebies for Piratopia 2.0.

https://discord.gg/JDwGHpvvbH

notes.title: 200.000 Organic Downloads
notes.content:
Hi Gladiators,

I'm ecstatic to reveal that the game has just passed 200.000 organic downloads!
That's like filling almost 2 of the largest stadiums of the world...

I never thought the game would achieve this as a solo developer with no marketing budget, and it's all thanks to you all, I'm very grateful to cross this milestone together!

I know a lot of you have been wondering why there haven't been updates or what's the future of the game, so I'll try to clarify it.

Currently, as a solo developer, I think I've reached the best I can do and I need people with stronger knowledge in areas I can't cover to deliver the game I have in mind and implement your suggestions.
Until that happens, unfortunately, the game will remain in standby and in EA stage, obviously free for you to enjoy.
At the same time, as a solo developer that enjoys the creative process of making games, I need to switch context and experiment with new games and mechanics to reach new players, expand our community and eventually bring passionate teams onboard to expand on the best games.

I know some of you might feel disappointed, I feel very sorry and I hope you could understand me aswell.

Please keep suggesting ideas in the forums or join our Discord to ask me questions directly, chat or just learning more about the new games!
https://discord.gg/QJ5S7Kr6fN

Thank you for sticking around and supporting me, Gladiators!

notes.title: Important Milestone!
notes.content:
Hello Gladiators, 

Important Milestone!!! The game just reached [b]100.000 downloads in less than 2 months[/b] with more than [b]2.000[/b] people playing the game every day, with zero marketing! Just... wow, I never expected this to happen and I thank every single one of you for this experience!

About the patch, it contains :
[list]
[*] Added verticality to the gladiatorium with high grounds. This should hopefully make the singleplayer more fun and experience even more goofy ragdoll moments.
[*] Losing a leg is not lethal anymore. You can still hop around with 1 leg but losing both is an insta death.
[*] Increase stamina cost when throwing weapons in multiplayer. The MP became more about throwing weapons and less sword-fights.
[*] Fix spawning position for the ballista and cannon in the endless mode.
[/list]
Something you've always asked is how to support me and show appreciation for this game.
So far I've always rejected any financial help because I wanted to first make a product you guys enjoy and see how far I can go with that.

The time has come for me to start building up funds that can further, not only grow this game, but other projects I have in the pipeline. 
I always want the game to be free of microtransactions so I've added an in-game donation button or click this link here to donate any amount.

https://www.paypal.com/donate?hosted_button_id=BQEWY54GMFJ6C

Thank you for sticking with me so far and showing amazing support!

Keep slaying, Gladiators!

notes.title: PvP and Stamina!
notes.content:
Hello Gladiators,

This patch reworks the stamina specifically for pvp and removes it from the single player modes.

The single player modes needs to remain fun and 'spammy' so people can enjoy the silly rag-dolls moments. 
PvP on the other hand doesn't have too many tactical decisions and it just isn't fun for players that want to get competitive or optimise movements and their decisions.

This patch contains :
[list]
[*] Disable the Stamina in Singleplayer modes.
[*] New Stamina in PvP which aims to reduce spam attacks and give op movements, such as grab / push, a bigger risk / reward factor.
[*] Ability to set the stamina on/off in custom lobbies.
[*] Introduce NPCs in the custom lobby.
[*] Several bug fixes.
[/list]
Let me know how this patch feels, join our discord to share ideas and suggestions
https://discord.gg/AFePFjQCsw 

Thank you, Gladiators!

Our Discord server has grown to almost [b]1,200 individuals[/b], every single one of them helping me to make the game better. It means a lot to me and I can't thank you enough for this!

notes.title: Balance and Stamina!
notes.content:
Hi Gladiators,

This new update tries to improve the stamina system especially for PvP.
The old stamina system was slowing your hits and you were recovering it only at the end of the animation. Also certain weapons and certain attacks were easily exploitable as there was not stamina punishment.

The new stamina system is similar to the old one, but you recover stamina all the time, even during attacks, effecting your animations. Also certain weapons (2 handed) have a different stamina cost for the light attack and the overhead one. This should make the overhead attack a more tactical choice.

The patch contains : 
[list]
[*] Nerf goblin health. They are generally too strong and too many, now they should be more of one-shottable.
[*] Nerf the fire rate of elephant archers.
[*] Make arrows not pickable from the player.
[*] Stamina mini-rework and rebalance.
[*] Rebalance some of the stamina costs of equipments.
[*] Increase stamina consumption of overhead attacks for the longswords, 2 handed mace and axe.
[*] Add Stamina HUD when low on stamina.
[/list]
Please join our community if you want to get involved in the development of patches and suggest changes or improvements.
https://discord.gg/AFePFjQCsw

I hope you guys enjoy this patch.

Keep slaying, Gladiators!

Todays patch introduces two new enemies and a combo.

[*] Cap fps to 90 as a good balance between framerate and not over-stressing your gpu.

[*] Minor fixes on pvp.
[/list]

https://discord.gg/AFePFjQCsw

I hope you guys enjoy this patch.

Keep slaying, Gladiators!

notes.title: PvP is Live! Now!
notes.content:
Hi Gladiators!

I'm super excited to announce that the first multiplayer features are live now! All for [b]FREE[/b]!
Join our discord to connect and maybe join custom matches or future tournaments.
https://discord.gg/AFePFjQCsw

This what the multiplayer contains :
[list]
[*] 1v1 Duels with ranks. Win duels to win trophies, lose duels to lose trophies. Unlock unique perks with trophies.
[*] Custom lobby. Host your own private or public lobby with up to 10 people or join a random one.
[*] New maps for the 1v1 and custom lobby.
[*] Voice chat in the multiplayer modes. You can turn this off in the settings.
[/list]
I personally can't wait to see fight you guys in the arena but multiplayer wasn't the only addition, here are some more :
[list]
[*] Add camera rotation assist. A lot of you complained, now the camera will assist your rotation when fighting enemies.
[*] Add an arena pets which you unlock through multiplayer.
[*] Add aura VFX which you unlock through multiplayer.
[*] Add audio settings.
[*] Support AZERTY keyboard for our french players.
[*] Rebalance (nerf) armours, they had to feel more rewarding and something to show off in multiplayer.
[*] Improve AI pathfinding so it's harder to cheese the enemies into traps.
[*] Add 'Pits' in the Gladiatorium. More ways to kill and get killed.
[*] Add 2 new enemies. Fat Ogre and Goblins. Goblins can ride Ogres for an unique combo.
[*] Add 'invincibility' in the first few frames when rolling. Skilful gladiators will be able to dodge roll almost any attack.
[*] Lots and lots of bugfixes!
[/list]
[b]Important about Multiplayer[/b]
As a solo dev, I can't afford servers, so it's all peer-to-peer and the lag varies depending on how far you guys are playing.
From the internal tests, it should be acceptable but please don't be too angry if things don't work well or if you encounter bugs.

As always I thank you all for following the development of the game, and leave a nice review if you are enjoying this :)

See you in the arena, Gladiators!

notes.title: PvP Status Update!
notes.content:
Hi Gladiators,

I know there has been some lack of updates but that's because all my effort have shifted to PvP.
Currently PvP is in beta testing and you can access it by joining our Discord server.
https://discord.gg/AFePFjQCsw

The multiplayer currently has : 
[list]
[*] 1v1 duels with a rank / leaderboard. You go up or down the leaderboard if you lose or win duels.
[*] 1v1 duels have 5 arenas, each has a different play-style and some of them have new traps / hazards.
[*] New visual effects to customise your gladiator based on the 1v1 rank.
[*] A new arena [b]pet[/b] that will help you in the singleplayer modes that unlocks based on the 1v1 rank.
[*] Rebalance (nerf) of the unlock rate of armour. Unlocking armour should feel a more important achievemen to show off in a 1v1.
[*] More settings like audio control, voice chat, AZERTY keyboard for our french players, camera assist etc..
[*] Minor bugfixes and improvements.
[/list]
What needs to get done before going live :
[list]
[*] Custom lobby. You'll be able to create custom rooms and invite friends to goof around in the arena or organise our/your own tournaments.
[*] Bugfixes and stability. The game runs very well and the lag is acceptable but there are still a few issues to iron out.
[/list]
I know it has been a long wait, but please be a bit more patience and soon you'll be able to slay real people in the arena or play around with your friends, all for free.

Please review the game if you haven't, it hugely supports the development!

Cya, hopefully, soon in the arena, Gladiators!

notes.title: Patch and PvP Update
notes.content:
Hi Gladiators,
this patch comes with a buff to the Grab/Push mechanic with the following changes
[list]
[*] You can grab while running. As long as you are aligned correctly at the right distance, you can grab and yeet an opponent while sprinting.
[*] You can run after executing a Grab. You are not forced to stay hard-locked into the walking stance while holding someone.
[/list]
Why these buffs ? Since the last grab change, the mechanic got nerfed considerably, making it almost useless... as one of the most fun mechanics, this is an attempt to bring it back especially for high rank players, but without being too overpowered.

It's also a balance needed for PvP...
... speaking of PvP, recently we've been running internal tests and the results are very promising!

The framework and network code is ready and the game plays smoothly. The first version of PvP will be in [b]beta[/b] in, hopefully, a week! And of course, this is all for [b]FREE[/b]!

Join the Discord Server, https://discord.gg/AFePFjQCsw , to get the latest updates.

I can't wait to see you gladiators slay each other in the arena.

Keep slaying, Gladiators!

notes.title: Better Checkpoint System!
notes.content:
Hello Gladiators,

This patch is a chunky one, so bare with me

[b]#Better Checkpoint System[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to have a checkpoint every 10 Glory levels... yes, not just a one time checkpoint.
[*] I know people will be screaming against this, so I've added an option to turn it off... also there are 2 leaderboards, one for the checkpoint progress and another for the hardcore players!
[/list]
[b]#Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*] Add 3 new weapons, two one-handed and one two-handed.
[*] Nerf the stickiness of the one and two handed swords.
[*] Fix the Flare.
[*] Nerf the AI damage when yielding weapons.
[/list]
[b]#Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] Buff the Roll, it should give you more space to evade enemy chained attacks.
[*] Introduce two "Environment Weapons", the Ballista and Cannon... can't wait to see you guys use them. You can practice them in the Practice level.
[*] Cap the max power to 200%.
[*] Performance Improvements
[/list]
Let me know how this patch plays, have fun Gladiators!

notes.title: New Game Mode!
notes.content:
Hello Gladiators, 

This patch comes with and new mode with it's own Leaderboard!
There are also some quality of like improvements.

[b]#1 New Mode - Endless Glory![/b]
Fight in the streets of Rome against endless waves of enemies, a new map with ever increasing difficulty. The more kills, the more health you'll gain, helping you stay alive longer.
Climb the new leaderboard and claim the glory you deserve at the top!

[b]#2 Quality of life fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Improve the [b]Grab/Push[/b]. A spam protection was introduced to prevent exploits but a lot of you hated it, so in this patch pressing [b]F[/b] the second time simply releases the opponent, with enough swing force you can throw him away.
[*] Add option to turn on/off the checkpoint at glory 10! A lot of you wanted the raw, difficult experience that the game offers, now you have the option to toggle it on/off.
[*] [b]Increase dismemberment thresholds[/b], this means less of those, not so fun, one shots from opponents.
[*] Improve stability of the character, less falling for no reason.
[/list]
I hope you enjoy the new patch, please comment in the community hub or on Discord if you want something changed or improved!

Also reviewing the game helps it grow on Steam, any positivity directly supports the game EVERY DAY!
Thank you Gladiators.

notes.title: One time Checkpoint!
notes.content:
Hello Gladiators, 
This patch comes with multiple fixes and improvements.

[b]#1 Add a one time checkpoint at Glory level 10.[/b]
A lot of you have been asking for a checkpoint system.
I was hesitant this whole time as it takes away the challenge but also I understand the frustration of having to restart from glory 1.
So I went for a something in the middle, a one time checkpoint when unlocking the leaderboard! 
Let me know how that plays.

[b]#2 Nerf the Grab Spam[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a spam protection on grab. People were abusing this in high ranks with cheats.
[*] Can’t run while grabbing.
[/list]
[b]#3 AI difficulty[/b]
[list]
[*] AI can’t grab with 1 arm.
[*] Reduce the AI grab frequency. You should be experiencing less ‘chained’ grabs.
[*] Can’t get grabbed when rolling or while getting up. It should give you a window to escape from chained attacks.
[*] Reduce the AI attack frequency a bit.
[/list]
[b]#4 Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] Buff the shield with an active, [b]shield bash[/b]. It pushes opponents.
[*] Performance improvements on later stages.
[*] Nerf the trident stick time.
[*] Buff the trident damage.
[*] Fix the stickiness of weapons, they were sticking more then they should.
[/list]
[b]Important[/b]
Because of the exploit fix and the changes, I need reset the leaderboard score for players that are above Glory level 21.
I understand the effort that went into it and I congratulate you but this is to keep the competition fair.

See you in the arena, Gladiators!

notes.title: Minor Balance and Control Update!
notes.content:
Hi Gladiators, 

This patch is a follow up of the control changes and after reading some reviews and watching gameplays. It contains : 
[list]
[*] Map [b]GRAB[/b] and [b]PUSH[/b] to the [b]F[/b] button. Not everyone has the middle mouse button.
[*] Lower trident stickiness. Getting hit by it often meant death, the stickiness has been reduced by 25%.
[*] Disable the glory demote on retry, it felt too punishing especially when physics glitched. It was exploitable anyway by going to the main menu.
[*] Increased the physics iteration count. Hopefully less glitches.
[*] Increase ‘stability’ of the character. Less falling down or tripping over.
[/list]
I know a lot of you want a way to rebind the controls, especially after getting used to the old setup. It'll be possible in the future but the priority right now is to get the default scheme right for most of users.
For most cases, If a button doesn't feel right and you want to rebind it then it means it's not a good bind in the first place.

Your feedback is what makes the game better, keep them coming!
Thank you, Gladiators

notes.title: Balance and Controls Update!
notes.content:
Hi Gladiators!
This patch is a mix of balance tweaks and improvements on the combat.

[b]Controls[/b]
A lot of you enjoyed the ability to Roll, so now it’s better integrated in the combat.
[list]
[*] Press [b]SPACE[/b] while walking to [b]ROLL[/b].
[*] Press [b]SPACE[/b] while running to [b]TACKLE[/b].
[*] Press the [b]middle mouse[/b] button to [b]GRAB[/b] and [b]PUSH[/b].
[/list]
It's useful to not only dodge incoming attacks or flying swords but to free yourself from traps or enemy thrusts. The combat should feels more skill-based and fun.

[b]Balance[/b] 
[list]
[*] Lower the amount of traps in the first few arenas. It’s frustrating getting stuck for early players.
[*] Adjust the difficulty steepness. Early levels should be a little easier.
[*] Lower the stickiness for some weapons, which a lot of you have complained about
---- 1 handed swords.
---- 2 handed swords.
---- Mace.
[/list]
[b]Important[/b]
Because of balance changes and the new controls, I need reset the leaderboard score for players that are above Glory level 30.
I understand the effort that went into it and I congratulate you but this is to keep the competition fair.

I hope you guys enjoy the new controls and the balance!

See you in the arena, Gladiators!

notes.title: Difficulty Balance #2!
notes.content:
Hi Gladiators,
While the early levels are easier and fun for a new player, the later ones are just boring after mastering the mechanics.
This patch aims to make the game a bit more challenging on the late game, specifically addressing the top ranks.

It also expands on the controls, providing you an escape from the nasty chained attacks (Looking at you Leopard).

#1 Increase AI aggressiveness for later levels by : 
[list]
[*] Buffing the AI equipment throw frequency.
[*] Buffing the AI group targeting. More enemies will try to duel you as you progress in the glory ranks.
[*] Buffing later levels.
[/list]
#2 Expand the controls with a [b]Roll[/b].
When grounded, press [b]SPACE[/b] to roll and control the direction with the movement keys.
It should help you get away from sticky situations or from attack chains.
The AI will learn how to roll in later levels, so executing them with an over-head attack will not be as easy as it was.

#3 Misc :
[list]
[*] Nerf the “Axe and slide” combo.
[*] Remove the 30 fps lock.
[*] Fix the allies targeting you.
[/list]
There will be no reset of the top ranks for this patch, but there might be one in the near future depending on the result of these changes.

Thank you Gladiators and keep dominating the arena!

notes.title: Difficulty Balance!
notes.content:
Hello Gladiators,

After reading your reviews, watching streams and checking the leaderboard, it seems that the initial part of the game is a little bit too hard and therefore frustrating for a lot of you.
This patch aims to address certain levels, fix some exploits and minor adjustments.
[list]
[*] Nerf the ‘Slide with trident’ equipped combo. Too OP which makes ranking up easy if exploited.
[*] Nerf punches so they don’t one shot. This is especially important in the initial levels.
[*] Nerf initial levels, it was getting too hard too quickly.
[*] Buff stamina regen. It was making the game too hard for casual players aka button smashers in the initial level.
[*] Fix bug with the bear that kept falling and glitching.
[*] Fix bug with the level 50+ arena was repeating.
[*] Improve AI targeting when the match starts. You can’t hide at the initial corner anymore.
[*] Lower the camera sensibility.
[/list]

[b]Important[/b]
Because of balance changes and the arena 50 bug, I'll reset the leaderboard score for the top 20 players in the Hall of Glory to give a fair playground to everybody underneath.
I understand the effort that went into being in the top 20 and I congratulate you but this is to keep the competition fair. Sorry.

Your feedback is what builds the game the way you guys want it. 
Keep them coming and keep slaying, Gladiators!

notes.title: Add Hall of Glory!
notes.content:
Hello Gladiators,

This patch will add a bit of spice for people that want to dominate the Gladiatorium.
It introduces the global leaderboard, Hall of Glory! This is the first version, so it's simple and straight forward.
[list]
[*] Add Global Leaderboard, Hall of Glory. Unlock it at [b]Glory 10[/b], after defeating the Knight and the Leopard.
[*] Nerf some of the key levels such as Minotaur or Leopard.
[*] Nerf a little bit the attack speed of the Leopard and Bear.
[*] Improve physics configuration for the Leopard and Bear.
[*] Lower the chance of getting one shot by a punch.
[*] Improve AI collision checks. Should be less dumb but still dumb.
[*] Revert the gore decal plugin version. It was causing hard crashes on certain hardware.
[/list]
[b]IMPORTANT[/b]
To have a fair start, your [b]best[/b] glory will not automatically upload, you need to make a new run to get it counted in the leaderboard.

Enjoy it and stay glorious, Gladiators.

notes.title: New Enemy Added!
notes.content:
Hi Gladiators!

A lot of you enjoyed the Leopard addition, so this patch expands on the Bestiarii experience.
It contains : 
[list]
[*] Add new enemy! I'll not spoil what it is but appears after level 20! Share a screenshot if you defeat him.
[*] Add saw blades as wall traps.
[*] Add a kill boost system. Restore some health and temporary gain power for every kill in the arena.
[*] Demote your glory every time you retry the level.
[*] Scale the character’s resistance to tackles and pushes as he grows in size.
[*] Scale the character grab range as he grows in size.
[*] Attempt to fix the Minotaur getting stuck in place.
[*] Automatically disable the footstep dust VFX after level 20 for performance.
[/list]
[b]What's next ?[/b]
PvP is the main feature that will add longevity to the game, so that's high priority at this point.

[b]How long will it take to have PvP ? [/b]
I don’t want to put a date since it’s quite an effort to have multiplayer, and I have limited bandwidth. So have patience gladiators, soon it's all i can say.

[b]Will we get updates in the meantime ?[/b]
Yes, I’ll add a leaderboard system so you can at least try to climb the glory ladder and smaller balance updates.

Thank you Gladiators for the great support.

Keep Slaying! Be Glorious!

notes.title: Patch of the Day!
notes.content:
Hello Gladiators!

Here are the new patch notes that aim to balance the game and improve the controls

[list]
[*] Reset the character stance to FOCUS (aka walk) after falling.
[*] Balance the stamina system. No more mindless spamming of attacks, after 3-4 consecutive attacks, your swings will be slower. Be more strategic!
[*] Minor improvements on animations.
[*] Nerf the over-the-head attacks to be less one-shot-y.
[*] The character will lean downwards towards a grounded enemy so you can execute them rather than waiting for them to get up.
[*] Introduce a targeting system. The character will lock and face towards the closest opponent at the front, it'll be easier to deliver and overall control the attacks.
[*] Fix the overlay tutorial not being persisted after a session.
[*] Introduce the stamina tutorial overlay.
[/list]

Any feedback is more then welcomed, thank you for supporting the game gladiators!

notes.title: Improved Controls!
notes.content:
Hello Gladiators!

After seeing your gameplays and reading your review, it's obvious something is not right on the controls.
This update aims to do important changes on the key mapping and the stances.

[list]
[*] Running (white cursor) is mapped on the [b]SHIFT[/b] key instead of SPACE.
[*] While running, you can go back to walking by pressing [b]SHIFT[/b] again.
[*] The character will go back to walking (yellow cursor) automatically when standing still.
[*] Grabbing and dashing is mapped on the [b]SPACE[/b] key instead of SHIFT.
[*] Attempt to fix the walking animation on certain frame-rates.
[/list]

Please let me know how these new controls feel to you.
I understand that for some of are already used with the old one and trust me, i felt the same way but after a few kills, they feel much better and easier to use.

Looking forward to hear your feedback gladiators!

notes.title: Balance Update!
notes.content:
Hello Gladiators!

Another day, another update patch based on your feedback

[list]
[*] Nerf the damage from throwing weapons. No more getting one shot from a random NPC.
[*] Nerf the "stickiness" of traps, everyone can agree that they are annoying.
[*] Fix and Improve the camera. Now it should function correctly, not getting on the way while slaying opponents.
[*] Increase the base damage of short weapons a little bit.
[/list]

Let me know if these are the fixes you were looking for!

Thank you Gladiators!

Hello Gladiators!

If you are, and you want to share your gameplay with everyone else, comment in this thread and I'll try to add you as an official broadcaster to stream your battles within the Steam platform.

The stream will appear on the main page and on the main search threads!

It's your chance to show everybody else your skills.

Thank you Gladiators!

notes.title: Bugfixes and Updates
notes.content:
Hello Gladiators, 

I've read your feedback and heard you screaming out loud about the controls.
The first patch is ready to, hopefully, help you on that, here are some points : 

[list]
[*] Increased the animation cool-down when spamming the attacks. It should not make you cancel attacks anymore.
[*] Make the player's character start in [b]FOCUS stance[/b], this will allow you to have more control over the direction of attacks and swings.
[*] Increase the stamina regeneration, attacks will not feel slow and boring.
[*] Added in-game overlay tutorials for the first 6 levels.
[*] Attempted a fix about the invisible weapons.
[/list]

Please let me know if these will improve your game experience.
Thank you Gladiators!

notes.title: Update on the Release Date
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

I'm sure a lot of you have been waiting to play Gladio and Glory the 12th of Feb but unfortunately, that date has changed and pushed to 19th of March.

[b]Why such a change ?[/b]
In order to deliver a stable game that all you [b]gladiators[/b] can truly enjoy, I need to spend extra time and effort on the build. 

The current build is playable and has the features and progression that I've promised in the store page but I just need extra time to nail down some of the nasty issues that might ruin the experience.

I've set a date that I feel comfortable to deliver the build but it might change depending on the progress... at the end of the day it's just one developer working on this and I don't want to put something that I don't feel it's stable enough for you guys.

Thank you [b]Gladiators[/b] for your patience and understanding.
